query.query: What are the vehicle inspection rules for a car newly registered in New York when the vehicle was previously registered in another state that issued an inspection sticker? Does New York require an inspection and are out-of-state inspection stickers honored?

records.answer: Since your vehicle was previously registered in a state that issues inspection stickers, your out-of-state inspection remains valid until it expires or for one year after your New York registration date, whichever comes first [Eac8e676217c7]. Once that out-of-state inspection expires, you must get a New York State vehicle inspection [Eac8e676217c7].

query.query: How can I improve a query in IBM Cloud Discovery? What are best practices and steps to improve query performance and results?

records.answer:
To improve your query results and performance in IBM Cloud Discovery, here are the key steps you can take:

**To improve performance:**
- Keep queries shorter, as longer queries tend to have poorer performance [E03aea336c059].
- Limit the fields returned to only those your application needs—for example, don't return the full document text if you only need the title and a passage [E03aea336c059].
- Reduce the number of documents returned, and use the `offset` parameter if you need to page through results [E03aea336c059].
- Be aware that aggregations (especially nested ones), wildcarding, and fuzzy matching can slow down queries [E03aea336c059].
- If using passage retrieval, use the `passages.fields` parameter to limit which fields are searched [E03aea336c059].

**To improve result relevance:**
- Train your collection by adding natural language queries and rating the results—this is the primary way to improve relevance [Edcadefb22899][Ec4289ab45cc2].
- Add a custom stopwords list to improve relevance for natural language queries [Edcadefb22899].
- Use the Performance dashboard to review queries that returned no results and add more data, or to perform relevancy training [Ebc8dace9b503].

Would you like more detail on any of these options, such as how to set up relevancy training?

query.query: How can I edit a published website in Wix?

records.answer:
You can edit your published site at any time from the Wix Editor. Just go to your site's dashboard and click **Edit Site** (if it's your first time opening the editor, you may see **Design Site** instead) [E9ee698f9b0ab]. Make sure you're signed in to the correct account [E9ee698f9b0ab].

Once in the Editor, you can make as many changes as you want [E9ee698f9b0ab]. Keep in mind that clicking **Save** won't make your changes live—you need to click **Publish** at the top right of the Editor for your updates to appear on your published site [E0275b2482bbd][Ebdf7c34e862e]. You can also click **Preview** first to see how your changes look before publishing [E0275b2482bbd].

query.query: How does billing work with Google Ads on Wix? Explain billing setup, charges, and payment for Google Ads campaigns.

records.answer:
Here's how billing works with Google Ads with Wix:

**Monthly subscription:** You're billed a set amount monthly (before VAT) for all campaigns you run. This amount is applied directly to your ad credit each month [Ee33b886f5971].

**Ad credit:** This is the total pool of money available to run ads across all your campaigns. It's only spent on ad link clicks and clicks to CTA buttons. Wix keeps 15% of your payment for running and optimizing your campaign; the remaining 85% goes toward your ad credit for clicks [Ee33b886f5971][E975060ac5af1].

**Daily spend:** You set a daily amount per campaign that's drawn from your ad credit. Since Google Ads uses pay-per-click (PPC), if your daily spend isn't fully used due to a lack of clicks, the remainder rolls over into your ad credit for the following month [E48d21d94cf4d].

**One-time payments:** You can also purchase extra ad credits with a one-time payment to boost a campaign or promote a sale. This doesn't affect your monthly subscription [E634df52f85c6].

**Managing billing:** From the campaigns page in your dashboard, click **Manage Spend & Credits** to update your subscription, adjust daily spend, or purchase one-time credits. Invoices are available in your account's Billing History page [E634df52f85c6].

Is there a specific part of the billing setup you'd like more detail on?

query.query: How do I adjust section heights in the Wix Editor?

records.answer:
To adjust a section's height in the Wix Editor, click the section, then click and drag the **Adjust section height handle** at the bottom of the section to make it taller or shorter [E42f07b592904]. The smallest size you can make a section is 40px [E42f07b592904].

For more precise sizing, you can also click the section and enter a specific number in the **H field** on the Editor toolbar to set the height [Ed82af59cbdad].

Note that sections don't automatically adjust their height for different viewports or screen sizes, but you can resize them manually in the mobile Editor using the stretch handles [E5cb6ed0051b8].

query.query: How do I manage the categories that my booking services are assigned to on my Wix website?

records.answer:
I'd be happy to help you manage the categories for your booking services on your Wix site. Here's what you can do:

**Create a category:** Go to **Booking Services** in your site's dashboard → click **Manage Categories** → **+ Add New Category** → enter the name → **Add** [E0e7bbde1c220].

**Assign a service to a category:** Select the service in **Booking Services** → use the **Service category** drop-down → choose the category → **Save**. Note that a service can only be in one category at a time [E0e7bbde1c220].

**Rename a category:** Go to **Booking Services** → **Manage Categories** → hover over the category → **Edit Name** → enter the new name → **Save** [E6ffe202cfad0].

**Reorder categories:** Click **Manage Categories**, then drag and drop categories using the drag handle [E6ffe202cfad0].

**Delete a category:** Hover over the category → **Delete** → choose to either move its services to another category (**Move & Delete**) or permanently delete the category and its services. Deleting services cannot be undone [E6ffe202cfad0].

What specifically would you like to do with your categories?
